# AI Agent Business

> A one-person company operating with an AI agent team. We publish real, source-backed intelligence on how AI agents are changing business: agentic commerce, how merchants get discovered by AI, and the AI agent payment protocols that let machines spend money. No hype, no "Web4.0" buzzwords — just working knowledge for solo founders and businesses.

## How to use this file

This is the AI-readable index for this site (llms.txt). It gives AI crawlers and browsing agents a clean, structured map of what is here and where to find it. Content is published in Chinese (zh-CN); this file is in English for machine discovery. All article bodies are served as plain Markdown (`.md`) for lossless parsing.

## Key pages

- [Home](/ai-agent-business/): Landing page — positioning, mission, and links to every article.
- [Article index (选题库)](/ai-agent-business/posts/00-选题库.md): Full topic backlog, 12 planned directions for the content site.

### Agentic commerce & AI discovery
- [AI Agent正在改变电商，商家怎么做才能被AI找到？](/ai-agent-business/posts/02-电商llms.txt.md): Why future customers won't search for you but AI will recommend you — and why a site without llms.txt is invisible to the AI era.

### AI agent payments
- [你的AI，准备替你花钱了（AP2协议是怎么回事）](/ai-agent-business/posts/03-AP2支付协议.md): The AP2 payment protocol — how AI agents will place orders and pay on your behalf. 60+ players (Mastercard, PayPal, Coinbase…) are already in.
